==Background==
"'''Nostalogic'''" is a J-pop, dance-pop, EDM, eurodance, electronic, electropop, pop rock song composed by yuukiss, featuring MEIKO, with additional lyric contribution by rose. The song became one of the triggers for the "Loli Meiko" also the development of the official derivative [[Sakine Meiko]] by [[Nanameue-P]] and [[Daigoman]]. The full version was featured in the album "''VOCALOID Produced by Yamaha''" under the name '''Nostalogic (THE VOCALOID edit)'''. The full version, featuring the PV by yumiko, was uploaded 2 years after the original, which surpassed the original in popularity.

A short WIP titled '''I Tried to Tune MEIKO Like a Loli in an Original Song''' was uploaded in September 2007, in which yuukiss had tuned MEIKO to sound younger than she naturally sounds. The song was an early version of Nostalogic. The song was further worked upon over the next four months, and received another short upload in late January 2008 under the name Nostalogic, showcasing the results up to that point. Compared to the WIP four months prior, the melody had been reworked into the finalized version, and the pitching of MEIKO improved. The finalized version of the song was uploaded seventeen days later in early February, which was the radio edit. The full version was included in the aforementioned album that released in September 2011.

The song has various meanings; it may tell of MEIKO who longed for the days of the past. Yuukiss has a tendency to add parts of lyrics / melodies to his other works (so they all are somehow connected); a melody of Nostalogic can be heard in the song "''[[FLOWER TAIL]]''" sung by [[KAITO]]; and "''FLOWER TAIL''" has similar lyrics with "''[[Fairy-taled]]''" sung by MEIKO. Some may interpret that, even though the genre and singers of the three songs are completely different, they may be related in terms of lyrics and melody.

On November 5, 2014, yuukiss uploaded a version called, "Nostalogic (MEIKO-SAN mix)" in celebration of MEIKO's 10th Anniversary. This version uses MEIKO's natural tone as opposed to "Loli Meiko". It was however, featured in the album ''[[EXIT TUNES PRESENTS Vocalospace feat. 初音ミク|Vocalospace]]'' beforehand. This day also marks where Nostalogic had reached #1 on NicoNico Daily VOCALOID Ranking.

On November 8, 2015 the single edit version had reached one million views, reaching the ''[[Hall of Legend]]''. Whereas the radio edit entered the Hall of Fame.

The word ''Nostalogic'' is a combination of ''nostalgia'' and ''logic''.
